exposure: experiencing stillbirths in the last five years
birth at the Mexican Institute of Social Security (IMSS) facilities
outcome: Prevalence of forced sterilization or contraception
Prevalence of forced consent on paperwork
cohort: Women who gave birth in Mexico in 2016 or 2021 (N = 24,036 in 2016, N = 19,322 in 2021)
finding: While the prevalence of most variations of non-consented care decreased, the overall prevalence of non-consented care and pressure to use contraceptives increased in Mexico between 2016 and 2021.
mod_finding: The prevalence of non-consented cesarean sections decreased nationally and in most regions of Mexico between 2016 and 2021.
